model.name: Qwen Image 2.1 Turbo 7B (Draft)
model.description: Draft mode for fast iteration: Qwen-Image-2.1-Turbo, a separately distilled checkpoint of the same 7B architecture, sampled with its published 8-step schedule at CFG 1. Shares the Qwen Image 2.1 text encoder, VAE and reference/edit workflows. Prepare the weights once with scripts/prepare_qwen21_turbo.py.
